articles.title: Wall Street's tokenization boom could have bigger winners than bitcoin and ether, Citrini says
articles.snippet: The research firm sees tokenized stocks, bonds and loans creating new markets for trading and lending, with fee-generating platforms and companies poised to benefit.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation spins out Veridian, tokenizes its shares on new standard
articles.snippet: Veridian became the first company to use Cardano’s new programmable-token standard for its equity, though the tokenized shares are not being offered to the public.

articles.title: Bitcoin and ether holders urged to enter ‘bunker mode’ against possible AI attacks
articles.snippet: Ethereum researchers warned AI could break the signatures guarding bitcoin, ether and the tokens built on them "in months, not years" in the worst case, well before quantum computers arrive.

articles.title: NUVA brings U.S. residential mortgage credit to offshore investors
articles.snippet: The company's HOME token gives eligible investors exposure to a vault of U.S. home equity lines of credit starting from 1 USDC and targets a 7% annual yield.

articles.title: Ripple is earning fees financing leveraged stock bets, a business long run by banks
articles.snippet: The crypto company's $1.25 billion acquisition of Hidden Road has opened a corner of Wall Street where funds pay to amplify daily moves in stocks such as Nvidia and Sandisk.
